{"type": "obligation", "text": "Focus on clear operational or educational benefits rather than implementing AI for its own sake.", "force": "recommendation", "binds": null, "responsible_party_stated": false, "mechanism_stated": null},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "Any AI system handling student information requires additional privacy protections and compliance considerations.", "force": "obligation", "binds": null, "responsible_party_stated": false, "mechanism_stated": null},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "Special education records, health information, disciplinary data, and family financial information all require enhanced safeguards when processed by AI.", "force": "obligation", "binds": null, "responsible_party_stated": false, "mechanism_stated": null},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "Data sharing agreements must specifically address AI use", "force": "obligation", "binds": "Data sharing agreements", "responsible_party_stated": false, "mechanism_stated": null},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "Always read the actual terms, not just marketing materials.", "force": "recommendation", "binds": null, "responsible_party_stated": false, "mechanism_stated": null},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "Consider long-term sustainability before committing to proprietary AI systems.", "force": "recommendation", "binds": null, "responsible_party_stated": false, "mechanism_stated": null},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "Avoid becoming dependent on systems you cannot control.", "force": "recommendation", "binds": null, "responsible_party_stated": false, "mechanism_stated": null},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "Deploy staff training before implementing AI systems.", "force": "obligation", "binds": null, "responsible_party_stated": false, "mechanism_stated": "before implementing AI systems"},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "Staff need to understand both capabilities and limitations, including accuracy issues and bias potential, before using AI tools with students or families.", "force": "obligation", "binds": "Staff", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": "before using AI tools with students or families"},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "Require human oversight for all AI outputs that affect students or families.", "force": "obligation", "binds": null, "responsible_party_stated": false, "mechanism_stated": "human oversight"},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "LEAs should consider prohibiting AI use for: Automated decisions affecting individual students (disciplinary actions, special education placement, etc.)", "force": "recommendation", "binds": "LEAs", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": null},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "LEAs should consider prohibiting AI use for: Social scoring or behavioral analysis of students", "force": "recommendation", "binds": "LEAs", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": null},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "LEAs should consider prohibiting AI use for: Mental health counseling or crisis intervention", "force": "recommendation", "binds": "LEAs", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": null},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "LEAs should consider prohibiting AI use for: Any use that could violate student privacy or civil rights", "force": "recommendation", "binds": "LEAs", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": null},
